M001.label: mixed
M001.quote: are indicative of power, wealth and riches by birth. However, note the simultaneous planetary dispositions indicative of loss of power.
M001.note: Prince born to wealth who lost many privileges in Venus-Mercury; conclusion explicitly two-sided.

M009.label: afflicted
M009.quote: In the Dasha of the Sun and the Moon the native was convicted several times for political offences.

M017.label: afflicted
M017.quote: The native was deserted by her husband three days after marriage. He was found to be a characterless cheat and debauchee.

M025.label: mixed
M025.quote: There are quite a number of Rajayogas which enabled the native to achieve a position that literally laid the whole of Europe under his feet. But the Rajayogas are loosely knit with the result the foundation of his career collapsed
M025.note: Napoleon: empire raised then collapsed in his lifetime.

M033.label: favourable
M033.quote: This made the Duke very rich; while not exceedingly rich according to world standards, he was always assured of a greater than "comfortable income".
M033.note: Conclusion found at line 13250, beyond the cited planetary-positions line.

M041.label: afflicted
M041.quote: The native committed a grave murder. Affliction to the 12th house is aggravated by the affliction to the Lagna as well. The native was incarcerated and then hanged.

M049.label: afflicted
M049.quote: Since the house and the lord are considerably afflicted, the Karaka's moderately benefice disposition should be ignored. The native, though married in 1930, has had no issues.

M057.label: afflicted
M057.quote: The native underwent an emergency operation for appendicitis about August 1926 which terminated fatally.

M065.label: favourable
M065.quote: It was in Mercury Dasa that he occupied various high offices — as Minister in a South Indian State, as a Prime Minister in a Central Indian State

M073.label: afflicted
M073.quote: As all the three factors, viz., the house, the lord and the Karaka are considerably afflicted, the 5th house is spoilt. The native has not so far got any issue

M081.label: afflicted
M081.quote: This is not good for mental peace and health, showing liability of trouble to the throat, speech and blood vessels.
M081.note: Stated as a liability from the afflicted Moon; no actual throat illness is reported.

M089.label: afflicted
M089.quote: Evidently these combinations have deprived the native of the "happiness" due from Kalatrabhava.

M097.label: favourable
M097.quote: The house of finance is well disposed... Throughout his life he was well off financially but for a temporary period when he was an impoverished man.
M097.note: Mostly favourable, with a short spell of poverty mentioned.

M105.label: favourable
M105.quote: All these, combined, rendered the circumstances very favourable for Truman to become Head of the State.

M113.label: favourable
M113.quote: Bose's eminence in his own field is due not a little to the position of Mars in the 10th in exaltation along with Rahu.

M121.label: afflicted
M121.quote: The native, a highly respected Indian political leader, underwent long terms of imprisonment for sedition, especially in Sun and Moon Dasha.

M129.label: favourable
M129.quote: Mark how the influences of Venus, Jupiter and Saturn have blended together in relation to the house of learning and how all these three planets have been strengthened
M129.note: The text says 'Chart No 16' (a misprint) inside the Chart 79 conclusion.

M137.label: favourable
M137.quote: Chart No. 240 is that of a trustee of a temple whose fabulous family properties have been set aside for feeding of pilgrims and other charities.
M137.note: Expenditure on charity; read as a fortunate use of the 12th.

M145.label: afflicted
M145.quote: But as the 5th house is afflicted and the 5th lord almost weak, their survival is not shown... No surviving issues now.
M145.note: Analysis paragraph is not named; matched to Chart 101 by its Aquarius 5th house (Chart 100's analysis has a Virgo 5th).

M153.label: afflicted
M153.quote: The Karaka and the lord being very weak, the mother's longevity is poor... Consequently, the mother's death took place in Jupiter Bhukti Rahu Dasha.

M161.label: none
M161.note: Timing example only: the father died in Saturn-Ketu (native aged about 50 or more). There is no judgment on the 9th house or the father's welfare; a reviewer could read this as afflicted.

M169.label: favourable
M169.quote: Lagna occupied by the Sun, the planet of vitality and Mercury, the planet of intelligence and aspected by Jupiter endowed the native with a healthy physique and good memory and intelligence.

M177.label: afflicted
M177.quote: He had no issues and this is corroborated by the presence of Ketu in the 5th house

M185.label: favourable
M185.quote: Rahu conferred on the native great name and fame as a scientist of international repute and gave wide travelling all over the world, great distinction, respect and responsibility.

M193.label: afflicted
M193.quote: Both the lord of the 7th and Venus have been much afflicted. The native disliked his wife and was a profligate.

M201.label: favourable
M201.quote: they account for the immense wealth and power the Maharaja commanded.
M201.note: Also notes friction with the Political Department, but he rose from peasant boy to ruler.

M209.label: afflicted
M209.quote: As both the 5th lord and the 5th house are considerably afflicted, the native has had no issues.

M217.label: none
M217.note: Only one factor is weighed ('association of Venus... with the Sun... is not conducive to domestic happiness'); no conclusion on marriage. Could be read as afflicted.

M225.label: favourable
M225.quote: Rahu in Cancer, and hence capable of producing the results of the Moon, gave him a successful medical career practically throughout his Dasa in a foreign land.
M225.note: Later spiritual fame in Jupiter Dasa is also favourable.

M233.label: favourable
M233.quote: Thus his "political career" was assured till the end, and no indications either for frustration or failure is seen in the horoscope.

M241.label: favourable
M241.quote: He had a magnetic personality, domineering and of very independent spirit. The Navamsa Lagna and the situation of Jupiter rendered his physical features very attractive.

M249.label: afflicted
M249.quote: Suffered from a severe type of typhoid fever in Venus Dasha, Venus Bhukti, Saturn Anlara.
M249.note: Also pneumonia, suspected T.B. and malignant malaria.

M257.label: mixed
M257.quote: The checkered financial career is due to the obviously unimportant position Dhanadhipati Saturn has been consigned to... Such dispositions generally denote financial stability giving way to difficulties
M257.note: Elsewhere Jupiter gave him money through a lucrative practice.

M265.label: afflicted
M265.quote: Hitler would have a violent end especially because of the powerful disposition of Mars.
M265.note: Death came at the fag end of Rahu-Moon (line 12227).

M273.label: afflicted
M273.quote: Marx attained no distinction as a statesman or as a ruler. The 10th house is rendered null and void because the lord Mars is neecha
M273.note: The 10th is judged void, yet Raman credits his intellectual and literary eminence to Mercury and Saturn instead.

M281.label: mixed
M281.quote: The Sun, lord of the 9th with Saturn, lord of the 2nd, has conferred undying fame on the native, but as the political planet is afflicted... his sufferings and sacrifics did not receive that gratitude
M281.note: Also 'a checkered career, suffering and confinement in chains' (line 10554).

M289.label: favourable
M289.quote: made him "a signal benefactor of posterity, statesman, ruler and liberator".
M289.note: Early career was chequered and poor, but he rose to President twice.

M297.label: afflicted
M297.quote: The 7th house is equally afflicted... Married happiness was almost nil. He married three times.

M305.label: mixed
M305.quote: Saturn as a Yogakaraka... conferred Raja Yoga in his Dasa... while retaining Farouk in power Saturn give rise to endless troubles
M305.note: Became king and was popular, then lost the throne (Raja Bhanga); Raman also says he 'brought ruin... upon himself'. Afflicted is defensible.

M313.label: favourable
M313.quote: The 7th house both from Lagna and the Moon being free of malefic influences gives a happy married life.
